completion_criteria: All current human review submissions and inline review threads have a documented disposition against the live PR head.
Historical chat conclusions are reconciled with current GitHub state and the exact-head v2 receipts; stale statements are labeled historical.
No existing claim or gate is duplicated, transferred, or treated as proof for another branch head.
The final reports and completion report are stored and read back at one coordination-v2 snapshot.
coordination_notes: This is a read-only review and documentation assignment. It does not authorize source edits, PR head changes, PR comments or body edits, JIRA comments, builds, tests, or new gate jobs.
The background docs are a snapshot from 2026-11-28 and are not a disposition of the live PRs.
PR 5257 and PR 5269 share related SOLR-17849 work. Do not assume a fix on one branch updates the other public PR.

At the source snapshot, the PR 5257 review-response Linux claim had been released without a receipt or verdict. The PR 5269 main-section Linux r2 receipt passed at c5955f3d47ffc8ff21bd59f77ae6846263ced4c6, but its claim had no matching release record in that snapshot.

At the source snapshot, PR 5284's merge-main r2 gate failed at 2cac1f8ccab414b17b52b31ccde0c62c4e024491, while its JSON bad-request r3 gate passed at 6de41c880893d8e5b1f0011a09f3c06aba7825bb and had a release record.
If any code change or Linux proof is later requested, create a separate exact-head assignment or gate after checking the current claim, release, worker state, and live source head.
deliverables: A per-review reconciliation matrix for each PR, including unresolved inline threads and current-head evidence.
A clear account of which branch or PR head each existing gate receipt covers, plus any gaps, unclaimed work, or missing release records.
Three final per-PR report records and one concise completion report linked to this assignment.
A read-back of each published record from a single resulting coordination-v2 snapshot.
scope: Refresh the live PR head, review decision, checks, issue comments, review submissions, and inline review threads before reconciling any prior note.
Map each reviewer request to the exact current diff and classify it as addressed, partially addressed, open, superseded, or outside the current PR scope. Cite the evidence and exact heads.
Reconcile the stacked SOLR-17849 work across PRs 5257 and 5269. Keep the public PR heads distinct from the corrected fork branches and their Linux receipts.
Reconcile PR 5284's failed round-two gate and passing round-three gate against the current PR head and the still-requested review decision.

Inspect the referenced coordination-v2 assignments, claims, releases, gates, receipts, and reports. Do not infer that a claim is inactive from a receipt or release alone; verify the recorded stop evidence and exact source head.
Publish immutable final documentation reports under records/report, one for each PR, and a completion report that links them.
summary: Reconcile current reviewer feedback, PR heads, related branches, and exact-head board evidence for Apache Solr PRs 5257, 5269, and 5284. Publish final per-PR documentation reports.
